name: Bench2Drive-V0.0.4-depth
description: Bench2Drive-V0.0.4-depth provides depth maps for driving scenes to evaluate dense depth estimation and perception modules for autonomous driving. It measures per-pixel depth prediction accuracy across varied road scenes and sensor configurations. The dataset is intended for benchmarking monocular or multi-view depth estimation and related dense-prediction algorithms.
evaluation_method: Depth estimation metrics (RMSE, AbsRel, SILog, delta accuracy)
reputation: A domain-specific driving-depth dataset used by perception researchers and autonomous-driving groups, with modest adoption so far.
